versions.changelog:
- Added Overpowered suite context and suite_url to metadata.
- Updated description to indicate skill is part of Overpowered suite.
- Changed section header to "Overpowered / Find Precedent."
- Removed skill-card.md file.

Initial release of the find-precedent skill.

- Enables users to search and compare relevant historical cases to inform current decisions.
- Emphasizes extracting reusable lessons and material differences, not treating precedent as authority.
- Provides a clear, structured procedure for identifying, analyzing, and synthesizing precedents.
- Outlines common pitfalls and clear guidelines for when no relevant precedent exists.
- Defines an output contract to standardize precedent reporting.
